name: Dennis Sullivan's house

status.note: Its later history is not researched here.

built.note: Standing in October 1871 (Andreas, volume two). Nobody recorded when it was built; 1864 stands in for the years before the fire.

summary: The house across the street from the O'Learys. Dennis Sullivan sat by its fence when he saw the barn burning. He ran across to help.

notable.text: The fire ran north and east, so the houses on this side of the street were spared.

story.text: Sullivan sees the fire across the street and raises the alarm.
